title: oxalis hidalgensis
intro: Oxalis hidalgensis, commonly known as the Hidalgo wood sorrel, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Oxalis genus. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis hidalgensis include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and display potential antidiabetic effects. The bioactive constituents of Oxalis hidalgensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
